It took me several years to finally get through my grief enough to leave this review.

A few years ago, my first cat was only 10 months old when he started losing his appetite, stopped eating, developed a swollen belly, and became weaker and weaker. I brought him to 4 Legged Friend, but the vet (an older female vet) only told me he had a fever, did something to control his temperature, and then asked us to come back the following week. That was the first time I had a cat. I had no experience, so I chose to trust the professional vet.

At the second visit, when he still wasn’t eating and was very weak, I was told that he was just a picky eater and to bring him back the next week.

By the third week, they finally told me to take him to an emergency hospital. After almost a month of delays, he didn’t make it. He passed away in the next morning.

When I saw that he didn't even have the strength to close his eyes. watching his pupils slowly dilate as life slipped away. I completely broke down. The vet even asked me why I was yelling at her. I believe the delay in recognizing how serious his condition was played a big part in what happened.

Please, please,always seek a second or even third opinion if something doesn’t feel right.

I've been bringing my fur baby to 4 Legged Friends since I got him during the pandemic. I can't believe he's almost 5 years old now.

Dr. Kudman and his team is just awesome. The front desk is the sweetest and the veterinary assistants are all very friendly. Dr. Kudman very honest with the charges to ensure there aren't any surprise charges. Also he doesn't pressure you do any procedures that may not be necessary. As a first time fur mommy, I was very worried when my little Tof first kept sneezing as a baby (not a common cold). Dr. Kudman gave a few possible reason of it and what are possible options if in continues. And funny thing is Dr. Kudman is actually allergic to cats but still showed great care to our little Tof.

They do grooming and other services.
They take care of all my dogs needs.

I can't say enough good things about this veterinary clinic. From the moment we walked in, everyone treated my dog and me with kindness, respect, and genuine compassion.

I brought my dog in because I found something on his face that had me very worried. The veterinarian examined him carefully, explained everything honestly, and thankfully it wasn't anything serious. I truly appreciated their honesty. They never tried to recommend unnecessary treatments or charge me for things Milo didn't need.

It's so refreshing to find a veterinary clinic that truly cares about animals instead of just making money. The staff is warm, professional, and the prices are fair. I left feeling relieved and grateful.

Thank you for taking such wonderful care of Milo. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for an honest and caring veterinarian.

Staff is very friendly. Place is not big, but organized. Clean.

Update - looks like they've expanded into the next building! The place is not cramped anymore. Staff is still awesome, and Dr. Kudman rocks
Dr Kudman and his staff are the best. I trust them with my furry child and I highly recommend them to anyone.

We had our first visit with this veterinary office last week for a routine check-up and vaccines, and both my husky and I left very happy with our experience. From the moment we walked in, everyone on the staff was incredibly kind, welcoming, and friendly. My girl has always been nervous about vet visits after having surgery a few years ago. Our previous veterinarian, who we absolutely loved, sadly passed away, so finding a new vet was not an easy decision. We received several recommendations for this clinic, and I’m so glad we chose to come here. As every pet owner knows, finding a veterinarian you can truly trust is hard—but we definitely got lucky. The doctor took the time to answer every single one of our questions and was so gentle, patient, and compassionate with my baby. We were both nervous, but the kindness of the doctor and the entire staff made the visit so much easier and more comfortable than we expected. I truly appreciate all the hard work and care you put into what you do. Thank you for making such a stressful experience a positive one. We already have our follow-up appointment scheduled for the rest of her vaccines and blood work, and this time I’m walking in feeling much more relaxed because I know we’re in great hands.
Good heart service.

I can’t recommend Four Legged Friends Vet enough. The entire staff is so warm and genuinely caring. It feels like they truly love animals and actually care about helping both the pets and their people. Everyone greets you with a smile the second you walk in and makes the whole visit feel easy and comfortable.

Dr. Q is the only vet I’ve seen there and she’s absolutely fantastic. She has such a big heart for the animals and never tries to push extra tests or treatments just to make money. You can tell her only priority is doing what’s truly best for your pet.

Our first kitten had a bad eye issue and we had a horrible experience at another vet. I left there feeling stressed out and totally hopeless. But Dr. Q took one look, reached out right away to an ophthalmologist to confirm no further testing was needed, and started treatment. He was like a brand new cat within a day, energetic, eating again, and playing like normal. She explained everything so clearly that I finally felt relieved.

After seeing how well he recovered, I brought in our second kitten and their mom too, and she took wonderful care of all three of them.

If you’re looking for a vet you can really trust with your furry family, this is the place. We’ve found our forever vet. Highly recommend! ❤️

Usually, I don't write reviews often, but I must express how grateful I am to Dr. Kudman. 5 stars does not even close to describe what a great doctor and person he is.

Yesterday, I had to make the final decision to put my 14 years old dog, Happy, to sleep. He was suffering from an aggressive cancerous tumor near his rectum. The tumor was egregious to the point where the flesh was split opened and the wounds were creating a rotten smell. My mother and I struggled to make this decision and have repeatedly sought for Dr. Kudman's advice in the past. He was extremely understanding and courteous, he gave us all the options we have and the effects of each option. The first few visits, my mother and I took Happy home because we couldn't stand the thought of losing him. But yesterday, we made the final decision that this was the best way to end his prolonging pain. My mother and I struggled to make the decision for over three and a half hours, and Dr. Kudman waited patiently the whole time. He let us spend time with Happy and reassured us that there was no rush. He let us know that we are his priority for that day, and he would wait for us for as long as we need. He said we can even take till after closing time, because he will wait for us. He grabbed chairs and tissues for us. His heart for his patients is genuine and unparalleled. I have never see a vet more patient and kind. He reassured me every step that there would be no pain for Happy. He patiently guided us through everything. In the end, my mother and I stayed with Happy the whole time while he went on his journey to the next life. We are genuinely thankful of Dr. Kudman and he told us he would take care of Happy's remains as if Happy was his own dog. The following day, Dr. Kudman even called to ask my mother how she was doing. Dr. Kudman truly has the biggest heart I have ever seen. I believe that he is someone that one can safely place the lives of their furry best friends in. I have a cat also and I will definitely keep visiting Dr. Kudman. Once again, I am sincerely grateful that there is a doctor out there that cares so much about animals. He is a doctor one can truly trust.

Edit: this happened over 8 years ago. I recommended my friends to see Dr. Kudman too and they still see him till this day. If I didn’t move I’d continue to see him
Caring doctors and staff!

This vet has been taking care of our Charlie for 10 years. Dr K and his staff are caring and friendly. Becky the receptionist is outstanding. Charlie loves the doctor 😊 Thank you Dr. K for always taking your time with us. …

I can’t even begin to express how much comfort and security I feel when I bring my dog here! I know there are tons of reviews already, but I just had to share my experience with anyone searching for a vet. I’ve had the best care with my dog here, and I’m so sorry I didn’t bring my previous pets. It all started with the office manager Debbie, who was so kind and warm on the phone. She had already set the tone! The staff was amazing, and Dr. Kudman was truly one of the best I’ve ever seen. He was thorough, professional, and incredibly kind—he’s a gem! I’d be happy to recommend him to anyone looking for a great vet to take care of their furry friends. My Valentina and I are so lucky to have found them!

I take both my cat and dog to Dr. Kudman and he does an excellent job both taking care of my animals and answering any questions I may have. He’s also very friendly and experienced. If you live in Brooklyn, this is the guy to go to.

We just went to the doctor with my two dogs!
They are doing good, friendly,I recommended that place 100%

They took in my new adopted cat last minute after noticing he kept vomiting every day. Checking in was very easy with simple paperwork. The didn’t take long to see my cat and the vet took her time figuring out the issue by asking many questions. After the examination, she gave me affordable options before doing expensive treatments. After choosing the affordable option, it didn’t take very long to receive the prescribed food. Now it’s been a couple of months since the visit. My cat is now in a much healthier weight and no longer vomits every day. I am very pleased with my experience.

Other things to be aware of: it is a very busy clinic. The front desk lady is handling calls, check ins, and payments at the same time.
They dint answer the calls keep u waiting bad service

Excellent Veterinary place I went there like 9 years ago they were excellent then and still excellent now the only downside I would say is that they don't have my records for my cat from back then they say everything is computerized now and they don't even know where they would find my cat's file come back then but once you're there the veterinarian I forgot his

name was it Dr William Kudman anyway he treats your dog or cat or animal with such respect and he doesn't try to drain your pocket because your animal your baby and say hug your baby while he's doing his procedure let them know that everything will be all right wow that's sticking the thermometer up your animals butt or drawing blood like they were my cat I also like the email of my cat's results everything was normal except her liver was a little elevated so they recommended

some liver vitamins and for me to retest her I guess in 3 months she also needs Oral Surgery and he was honest enough to tell me he'll be as safe as possible but it's not 100% safe unless you go to a board certified oral surgeon which is more money of course so I appreciate his honesty and of course I want to take my cat to a board certified oral surgeon instead of making him do it so that's my experience he was very good very honest

and I definitely recommend this place the full panel blood test to test for everything was around $340 bucks and the office visit is cheapest like $79.00 definitely recommend this place

Absolutely Horrible Experience Shockingly Careless

I scheduled an appointment for my cat who urgently needed care—he had been vomiting, was severely dehydrated, and had a high respiratory rate. Unfortunately, traffic caused me to run a few minutes late, so I called the clinic to let them know.

The woman who answered the phone was incredibly careless and dismissive. Before even listening, she kept repeating, “It doesn’t matter, it doesn’t matter, no—we can’t take you,” with zero consideration or understanding of the situation. I explained that my cat needed urgent attention, but she refused to even check with the doctor, claiming the doctor “needs to leave” and can’t see him.

This level of indifference toward a sick, suffering animal is unacceptable. This was my first and definitely my last experience with this clinic, didn’t even give me a chance to visit them once, they lost a patient who would’ve been a regular patient. I would never trust them with my pet’s care after witnessing how little compassion and professionalism they showed in an urgent care needed.

I've been bringing my four cats to Dr. Kudman for several years and he is an amazing vet.  My cat, Stella, had to be euthanized last week because she was 20 years old and had multiple health issues. Dr. Kudman and staff were incredible. I was allowed to stay through the whole process and after it was done  gave me plenty of time to say goodbye. I was never rushed or pressured. They were compassionate and empathetic. I've always received great service from Dr. Kudman and staff and this was no different.  Highly recommended for pet parents.
This the place you wanna bring you’re pet to because they actually care , Everytime my dog has been there always good even very patient and gentle with your pet

I’m so grateful we came to this clinic today. The staff was kind and caring. My cat usually doesn’t like vets and can be pretty aggressive, but here two wonderful nurses (I wish I had caught their names) and the amazing Dr. Igor Brodetsky managed to find the right approach. My cat actually let them examine him — which feels like a miracle. The doctor spent so much time with us, and that was truly unusual for me, because in 10 years I’ve never seen a clinic where they treat both the pet and the owner with such kindness and attention. Compared to the four other clinics we’ve been to, this place is on a completely different level. Real professionals and absolutely wonderful people! Thank you.

Dr. Kuddman and staff, very caring and knowledgeable folks. Mr. Pickles and Oreo are very happy to have 4 Legged friends to help them when they are under the weather. Kudmann and staff go above and beyond to help my cats. Plus kudmann smusheeez my cat like I do. I don't know what else to say, except for when people love what they do, they do it well...that is hard to find. These are the vet family to go to. 4 LEGGED FRIENDS ARE THE BESTEST OF THE BESTEST.

Receptionist and staff are kind and helpful.

He always tells it like it is and works with you to come up with a plan that is right for you and your pet. I've recently seen Dr. Balsam a couple of times too, who also impressed me with her thoroughness in caring for my cat who is unfortunately now very ill. I knew many of the staff, the manager, front desk people and technicians, from the Kings Highway office and love all of them as well as the Bath Avenue "originals" whom I'm getting to know now. Everyone's great. Your pets will be in good hands with all the doctors and staff at 4 Legged Friends.

she then calls me on the day of his supposed day of surgery 8/13, forgetting that she told me on the 11th that he had NO SCHEDULED APPOINTMENT.

Dr. Kudman and the entire staff are to be congratulated for their

I have two cats and Dr.kudman + vet techs have been so kind. Amazing care and easy to schedule appointments.
